text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Customer 'Sparrow Labs' on Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu2' is reporting elevated 502/504 and gateway timeouts. Error rate spike detected in ingress gateway and model-serving nodes. Auto-pager engaged.

alex (oncall): I'm on it. Paging ops-lee and jordan.

ops-lee: looking. seeing a big tail of 504s from svc/model-proxy -> model-worker. 95th latency for inference across the cluster jumped to ~4.2s.

jordan (ml-eng): the model variant they pinned has heavier memory working set. Could be KV thrashing. Any KV eviction logs?

ops-lee: grep'd the node logs quick — eviction spikes on kv-cache on gpunode-17. CPU ok but GPU mem near full, kswap? here's snippet:

```
Mar 15 12:05:23 gpunode-17 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (model-worker) score 987 or sacrifice child
Mar 15 12:05:24 model-worker[23456]: KV cache eviction triggered: drop_prefix=true evicted=1243
Mar 15 12:05:24 gateway[1122]: upstream "model-proxy" returned 504
```

alex (oncall): sounds like noisy neighbor + model working set exhaustion. What's current concurrency policy on their route?

ryan (devexp): Sparrow's route has concurrency=24 and batching enabled (dynamic). They recently increased batch size in their rollout.

sandra (infra): autoscaler hasn't spun extra nodes because we've hit per-tenant cap on that dedicated pool. Also some nodes show elevated disk IO from checkpointing jobs (customer unrelated) on same pool.

maya (cs): Sparrow support reports timeouts hitting their customers; they see 20% request failures in last 10m. They can take degraded throughput but want clarity. On call with their SRE now.

alex (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle Sparrow route to reduce concurrency 2) disable batching for their route 3) reroute a small % of traffic to fallback model-quantized variant 4) request temporary capacity uplift from infra. Who can execute 1-3 now?

ops-lee: I'll patch the routing policy. Doing:

```
# set concurrency limit to 6 for customer:sparrow
redwood-cli routes update --customer sparrow --concurrency 6 --no-batching
```

ops-lee: applied. Confirming new token-level logs show concurrency drop.

incident-bot: ACTION: Route update applied by ops-lee at 12:08:10 UTC.

jordan (ml-eng): I'll enable fallback routing to the quantized model (sparrow-v1-q4f16) for 10% traffic. That should reduce memory & KV pressure.

jordan (ml-eng): applying canary route: `redwood-cli rollout add --route sparrow --variant sparrow-v1-q4f16 --percent 10`

incident-bot: ACTION: Canary rollout initiated by jordan at 12:09:03 UTC.

sandra (infra): I'm requesting a capacity uplift but need approval for quota bump on dedicated-eu2. Opening ticket to infra-ops. ETA 18m unless emergency override.

alex (oncall): good. Maya, tell Sparrow SRE we throttled concurrency and started canary to reduce load; ask them to hold non-urgent large batch jobs.

maya (cs): on the call now — they confirmed stopping bulk scoring jobs. Appreciate the canary. They've asked for an ETA to full recovery.

ops-lee: monitoring: 502/504 rates dropped from 18% -> 7% in 3m since throttle+no-batching. Latency P95 also down to ~1.8s.

alex (oncall): keep watch. If errors hold >5% for 10m, we escalate to pool-level eviction mitigation (eviction window increase, move noisy tenant).

jordan (ml-eng): also noticed model-worker logs showing repeated partial checkpoint writes during inference leading to IO contention. That matches sandbox jobs on same pool. We should isolate inference nodes from background checkpoints.

sandra (infra): noted. I'll set soft-affinity to de-prioritize checkpointing jobs on nodes hosting dedicated-eu2 customers. Pushing CR now.

ops-lee: Canary traffic on quantized variant shows error rate ~1.2% and lower memory footprint. This is promising for safe ramp.

alex (oncall): plan for next 15m: 1) hold current throttles 2) ramp canary to 40% if metrics stable 3) continue infra capacity request 4) post-update to Sparrow CS with timeline

maya (cs): Sparrow accepts staged ramp. I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up with them and log the mitigation steps.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 45m to sandra. Current incident severity: SEV-2 (Customer impact, degraded throughput).

ryan (devexp): quick idea for long-term: add heuristic in routing to detect high KV eviction deltas and auto-enable quantized fallback before throttling. Filing an RFC.

alex (oncall): good. For now I'll stay owning until handoff. ops-lee, jordan -- please keep watch on gateway error rate and memory/eviction metrics. Post any regression here.

ops-lee: Will do. Posting follow-up metrics in 5m.

jordan (ml-eng): If we stabilize, propose next steps postmortem: root cause (noisy background checkpoint + tenant batch config), fix (isolate background IO, auto-fallback), and customer remediation credit.

maya (cs): Sparrow asked for SLA credit guidance. I'll coordinate once incident closes.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Updating incident channel and incident tracker.

ops-lee: 12:15 update: 502/504 down to 3.5%, P95 ~1.4s. Canary at 20% now. Looks headed in right direction.

sandra (infra): quota uplift approved as emergency for 30m window. Spun up 2 spare nodes for dedicated-eu2. Starting drain/migrate knobs.

incident-bot: ACTION: emergency capacity uplift granted by infra at 12:22:40 UTC.

alex (oncall): excellent. We'll keep throttles for 10 more minutes and then slowly relax if metrics hold. Preparing handoff notes to sandra.

pager: acknowledged. Handing off to sandra at 12:30 UTC for monitoring until stable.

sandra (infra): got it. I'll monitor and push isolation patch and follow-up CR. Closing timeline entry in tracker.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: errors reduced, capacity uplift performed, canary in progress. On-call handoff planned.

alex (oncall): final — create postmortem ticket and include customer impact numbers, timeline, and proposed infra/behavioral mitigations. I'll flag for priority.

maya (cs): will draft customer communication and share for review.

(END)
